scene_records.slugline: SCENE 1: INT. ANCESTRAL HOMESTEAD - LIVING HALL - EARLY MORNING
scene_records.short_summary: Amar returns with the unsealed municipal partition envelope; challenged by Bebe and Rohan.
scene_records.dramatic_purpose: Establish central stakes of debt foreclosure versus ancestral soil pride.
scene_records.emotional_change: From awkward reunion silence to bitter family clash.

scene_records.slugline: SCENE 2: EXT. FAMILY ORCHARD - CANAL TUBE-WELL - AFTERNOON
scene_records.mood: Hostile, aggressive clash over life-giving irrigation water
scene_records.short_summary: Amar brings the blueprint to surveyor Gurdip; Rohan arrives armed with a spanner.
scene_records.dramatic_purpose: Expose that partitioning the ditch severs water access for neighboring farms.
scene_records.emotional_change: From bureaucratic transaction to visceral physical confrontation.

scene_records.slugline: SCENE 3: INT. HOMESTEAD COURTYARD AND KITCHEN - DUSK
scene_records.short_summary: Amar breaks down before Bebe, confessing the catastrophic bankruptcy of his city venture.
scene_records.dramatic_purpose: The emotional turning point: shifting Amar from avoidance to admission.
scene_records.emotional_change: Amar moves from avoidance and false pride to raw confession and emotional redemption.

scene_records.slugline: SCENE 4: EXT. ANCESTRAL BOUNDARY BANYAN TREE - NIGHT
scene_records.short_summary: Amar meets Rohan at the ancient stone marker, discards the deed petition, and offers his own physical labor to pay the debt.
scene_records.dramatic_purpose: Resolution: brotherhood and soil integrity win over financial subdivision.
scene_records.emotional_change: From fraternal estrangement to fierce reconciliation and shared responsibility.
